title: My first Godot demo, made entirely through conversations with Codex
author: GKPT9524
selftext:
​

Hey everyone! English isn't my native language, so please excuse any grammar mistakes.

I'm a game developer who recently switched from Unity to Godot. I barely know anything about Godot yet, but I managed to create this stylized rendering demo just by chatting with Codex and providing a few reference images. I didn't manually write any code or make any changes myself.

I'm really happy with how it turned out, especially since I love this kind of stylized rendering.

However, I have mixed feelings about AI-assisted development. I'd love to create more rendering styles, but the whole process feels like a black box to me. I don't really know how to reproduce the results myself, and I'm not sure how much of this rendering ability is actually mine.

I'd love to hear how other developers feel about this. Do you ever feel the same way when using AI?
